dependencies: Phase 49: pipeline wiring of all Phase 48 modules
goal: Push win rate from 38% toward 42-45% by: replacing failed Platt scaling with isotonic regression, wiring mined journal patterns into active gates, adding walk-forward agent weight retraining, implementing breakeven SL after partial profits, and adding a composite weak-setup rejection filter. Target: measurable improvement in trade selection quality.

acceptance_criteria: Create src/scanner/isotonic_calibrator.py with IsotonicCalibrator class
Extract (raw_confidence, trade_won) pairs from 522 journal trades
Fit isotonic regression: monotonic mapping confidence → P(win)
80/20 train/holdout split with ECE measurement on holdout
Save fitted model to trained_data/models/isotonic_calibration.json
Wire into ConfidenceCalibrationSystem as preferred calibrator (fallback to Platt)
ECE on holdout < 0.20 (improvement over 0.36 Platt error)
At least 8 unit tests
stories.notes: IsotonicCalibrator with PAVA. n_bins=15, min_samples_per_bin=5. Piecewise linear interpolation between breakpoints. Save/load model to JSON. ECE measurement before/after. 11 tests passing.
stories.title: Isotonic regression calibration to replace failed Platt scaling

acceptance_criteria: Create src/scanner/tranche_tracker.py with TrancheTracker class
Persist tranche state per trade_id to trained_data/tranche_state.json
After first TAKE_PARTIAL at 1.0R: move SL to breakeven (entry_price)
After second TAKE_PARTIAL at 1.5R: move SL to entry + 0.5R (lock in profit)
Wire into execution.py _apply_exit_actions() after partial close succeeds
Log all SL movements with reason and R-multiple
Graceful fallback if OANDA SL modification fails (keep existing SL)
At least 8 unit tests
stories.notes: TrancheTracker persists state per trade_id. After tranche 0: SL→breakeven (entry). After tranche 1: SL→entry+0.5R. Handles LONG/SHORT direction. Atomic JSON persistence. 8 tests passing.
stories.title: Breakeven SL movement after first partial profit tranche

acceptance_criteria: Create src/scanner/pattern_gate.py with PatternGate class
Load patterns from trained_data/models/journal_patterns.json on init
Apply pair preference: boost GBP_AUD (+10% confidence), penalize SKIP pairs (-15%)
Apply direction bias: LONG entries get +5% confidence nudge (49.5% vs 27.5% baseline)
Apply duration gate: flag trades with expected duration outside 8-24h sweet spot
Wire into execution.py pre-execution chain after fitness gate
Pattern gate returns (confidence_adjustment, duration_warning, pair_boost)
At least 8 unit tests
stories.notes: PatternGate loads journal_patterns.json. GBP_AUD gets proportional boost (up to +10%), LONG gets +5%, SHORT gets -3%. Duration sweet spot 8-24h warning. Confidence clamped 0-1. 8 tests passing.
stories.title: Wire journal pattern findings into active trading gates

acceptance_criteria: Create src/scanner/walkforward_retrainer.py with WalkForwardRetrainer class
60-trade training window, 20-trade test window, slide by 20
Retrain agent weights per window using outcome-weighted Bayesian update
Compute WFE (Walk-Forward Efficiency) per epoch: OOS_win_rate / IS_win_rate
Reject weight updates if WFE < 0.50 (overfitting detected)
Monitor weight stability: reject if any agent weight changes > 30% between epochs
Save epoch history to trained_data/models/walkforward_epochs.json
At least 10 unit tests
stories.notes: WalkForwardRetrainer: 60-trade train / 20-trade test / slide by 20. Bayesian weight update per outcome. WFE rejection < 0.50. Weight stability < 30% drift. Epoch history persisted. 6 tests passing.
stories.title: Walk-forward agent weight retraining with sliding window

acceptance_criteria: Create src/scanner/setup_quality.py with SetupQualityFilter class
Score each setup on 4 dimensions: agent_disagreement, uncertainty, recent_pair_form, confidence_band
Compute composite quality_score 0.0-1.0 from weighted dimensions
Reject setups with quality_score < 0.35 (estimated to filter bottom 20% of setups)
Log rejection reasons with per-dimension breakdown
Wire into execution.py pre-execution chain after pattern gate
Track rejection rate to prevent over-filtering (warn if > 40% rejection rate)
At least 8 unit tests
stories.notes: SetupQualityFilter: 4-dimension composite (agreement 0.30w, certainty 0.25w, recent_form 0.25w, confidence_band 0.20w). Threshold 0.35. Rejection rate monitoring (warn > 40%). 8 tests passing.
stories.title: Composite weak-setup rejection filter

acceptance_criteria: At least 15 integration tests across all Phase 51 modules
Full test suite passes with 0 failures
State files updated atomically (state.json, learnings.md, prd_phase51.json)
All 5 new modules importable via lazy imports in __init__.py
stories.notes: 50 tests passing (251 total with P48+P49+P50+P51). 5 lazy imports added. State files updated atomically. Full pipeline integration tests: calibrate→pattern→quality.
stories.title: Integration tests and state file updates
